card: One job event refetches every watched ledger page: scope invalidation
tests_added: apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::case 1: a job for r1 refetches r1's ledger page only, r2's is untouched
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::case 2: a complete runs listing for T without sbx-1 -> 0 fetches; a run of T -> the chain refetches
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::case 3 (guard): T's runs listing is partial and no cached row mentions the run -> the chain IS invalidated
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::case 4 (guard): the daemon engine ledger refetches on every job event
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::case 5: clips.approve c1 refetches clips.get c1 plus clips.list, not clips.get c2
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::case 6: five job events for r1 inside one 250 ms window -> one fetch per watched key
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::case 7: a misspelt method or event type is a tsc error
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::guard: refetches every entry whose scope holds the run (its run, its tournament, the engine ledger), job and segment_end
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::guard: an event with no run id invalidates as broadly as before
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::guard: a complete listing that is refetching (a run just started) proves nothing
apps/console/src/data/invalidation.test.ts::guard: a filtered or partial chain is never taken as complete
guard_cases: affected-run matrix (run / tournament / engine ledger, job + segment_end)
deviations_from_card: (1) Coalescing applies to event invalidations only; mutation refetches stay immediate (an operator action, not a burst, and page tests rely on it). (2) stream_end stays method-wide (once per run, and it also invalidates runs listings); only job and segment_end are scoped. (3) A runs listing proves a run irrelevant only when every page is fresh (ready, not stale, no refetch in flight), unfiltered, covers T (tournament_id T or none) and the chain is cursor-complete; any cached row tying the run to T, at any freshness, forces the refetch. (4) Tests and implementation are one commit: case 7 (typed tables, @ts-expect-error) cannot compile before the tables exist. (5) Coupled files outside the write set: perf/draws.test.tsx and perf/commits.test.tsx now advance DEFAULT_COALESCE_MS after a push; apps/console/budgets/bundle.json entry js 294,500 -> 296,500 (measured 294,162 -> 296,211 B) under the lock, committed alone as e9f47c3. invalidatedByEvent/invalidatedByMutation kept (brain layer2.test uses them).
notes: Red before: cases 1, 2, 5 and 6 in vitest, case 7 in tsc. QueryCache.onEvent now takes {type, runId}; QueryCache.invalidate(methods) is unchanged. Known limit: if the daemon answers a runs listing before a just-started run's directory is listed, and that run's stream_start refetch has already landed, job events for that run could skip the tournament ledger chain until stream_end or the 5-minute backstop. The freshness rule covers the case where the refetch is still in flight.
